title: Dodger Stadium

terrainReference.basis: Original USGS sample at the playing field near the site anchor. Each stand rises from the same field datum.

mapIdentity.scope: Measured OpenStreetMap outer and inner spectator boundaries, separate pavilion footprints and three components of the mapped playing field. Main stand offsets are sampled across the mapped envelope at two-degree intervals.

note: Dug into the Elysian Park hillside, with approximate finished deck heights following the published elevations and original 3DEP context.
